description: This PHP class defines a scaffold operation for replacing files, either by copying or symlinking, within a Drupal project using Composer. It manages file overwriting, copying, symlinking, and related operations.

classes.name: ReplaceOp
classes.description: A class that performs replace operations on files, either copying or symlinking from a source to a destination within a Drupal project scaffold.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ReplaceOp with a source file path and an overwrite flag.

methods.name: generateContents
methods.description: Reads and returns the contents of the source file.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Performs the replace operation, copying or symlinking the source file to the destination, respecting overwrite and symlink options.

methods.name: copyScaffold
methods.description: Copies the source file to the destination path.

methods.name: symlinkScaffold
methods.description: Creates a symlink from the source file to the destination path.
